relationship_note: Repeated views do not represent additional animals. No cross-publication pooling; source labels preserved.
scale_note: Own printed horizontal scale stroke: endpoints refined from the dark stroke on the same 4-pixels/PDF-point source crop. Short scale bar; physical area is sensitive to endpoint placement.

rois.label: SI dorsal myelinated island
rois.boundary_note: Only the explicitly SI-labelled closed dorsal myelinated island is measured. This is an architectural patch, not the complete SI envelope. Retained source scale is very short (about 14 pixels at 2 pixels/PDF point).
rois.tracing_method: Source closed-cell union and dense outer contour; source-reviewed. Internal glyph holes retained within anatomical envelope.

rois.label: SI lateral myelinated island

rois.tracing_method: Source closed-cell union and dense outer contour; source-reviewed. Internal glyph holes retained within anatomical envelope.

rois.label: Auditory envelope (dashed)
rois.boundary_note: Source labels this small dashed envelope AUD. Short intervals between visible dashes are interpolated; borders adjacent to AUD lettering remain approximate. Not a precise primary auditory field identification.
rois.tracing_method: source-guided dense contour with visual review
